title: Lowerys
description:
Lowerys is a provider of office supplies, printing, and photocopying services, catering to businesses and individuals in Thunder Bay and Fort Frances. They offer a wide range of products including office supplies, janitorial supplies, and managed IT services. With a history of 100 years, Lowerys emphasizes local shopping and provides a price match guarantee. Their services also include wide format printing and bottled water solutions. 
The company headquarters is located in 540 Central Avenue, Thunder Bay, ON P7B 6B4, Canada. 51-200 Employees
